exposure: timing of exposure to alcohol during pregnancy (first trimester only, throughout all 3 trimesters, first and second trimesters, third trimester only)
type of alcohol consumed (beer, wine, liquor)
cohort: The study included 595 women who consumed alcohol during pregnancy, with data gathered from 5 hospital sites across the United States.
finding: Machine learning algorithms, particularly CatBoost, demonstrated high prediction performance (AUROC 0.92) for identifying FAS risk among pregnant drinkers, outperforming previous models.
